data.title: Mets predicted to win bidding war for $32M two-time Cy Young winner to stabilize rotation - www.sportingnews.com
data.content: # Mets predicted to win bidding war for $32M two-time Cy Young winner to stabilize rotation. It is no secret that the New York Mets were baseball's most disappointing team in 2026, with injuries and poor play contributing to their struggles. This offseason will be a significant one for the organization as it looks to put together the right roster for a turnaround. Whether it is the bullpen or the starting rotation, New York is going to need to add pitching this offseason. Upgrading the starting rotation remains a top priority, but the Mets also need to revamp their bullpen after trading away four relievers at the deadline,” SI’s Tommy Kelson wrote. One thing that is clear in New York is that Nolan McLean has all the talent necessary to become the team's ace in 2027 and beyond. Landing the biggest fish of all on the market would provide all that and meet a clear need,” Perry wrote.

data.content: # Braves predicted to sign $6.2M starter who had career resurgence with Orioles to be Chris Sale heir. As the page turns to 2027, it's to see how it shakes up. But all three dealt with injuries and can't be counted on to pitch in 2027," The Athletic's Jesus Cano wrote. With so much uncertainty surrounding the rotation, the Braves are expected to be aggressive in addressing their pitching needs. “The Braves were hit with a litany of pitching injuries last season and still won the division, but there are a ton of question marks here. He could eventually become Chris Sale’s successor as the top left-handed option in Atlanta's rotation.

data.title: USMNT roster for November 2026: Predicted squad for two CONCACAF Nations League matches vs. Haiti - Sporting News
data.content: # USMNT roster for November 2026: Predicted squad for two CONCACAF Nations League matches vs. The United States men will make their first foray into competitive football since the end of the 2026 FIFA World Cup as they meet Haiti for a pair of matches in the CONCACAF Nations League quarterfinals this November. The aggregate winner of this two-legged quarterfinal will advance to the semifinals, additionally earning qualification in the 2027 CONCACAF Gold Cup. The Sporting News brings you a look at how the USMNT roster for the CONCACAF Nations League quarterfinal might look once it has been officially unveiled. ## USMNT roster for November 2026 matches vs. Pochettino is expected to call around 26 players for the pair of CONCACAF Nations League quarterfinal matches against Haiti in November. The USMNT head coach called in 28 players for the four friendlies in September and October, but that size is likely to be trimmed for this international break with only the standard two matches to navigate instead of the inflated four from the last window.

data.title: Dan Lanning Breaks Down Decision Behind Current Offensive Line Rotation - Sports Illustrated
data.content: The Oregon Ducks offensive line found a rhythm after plenty of ups and downs and coach Dan Lanning's preseason promise of a six to eight player rotation. It's no secret that the No. 23 Oregon Ducks (5-3 overall, 4-1 Big Ten) have struggled throughout the 2026 regular season with finding a successful lineup in the offensive trenches, particularly in the tackle slots. However, it seems that the 34-26 win over Northwestern at Autzen Stadium finally solidified the front five, with the Ducks utilizing their first consecutive starting group this year to produce the fourth-highest overall offensive yards of the season, second-highest passing yards of the season, and a season-low zero offensive penalties for a much-needed win. There's also the factor of injuries pursuing throughout the season that could impact Oregon's current trench rotation. "You talk about winning the line of scrimmage, and some of those were just necessary reps to get us to the point to where we felt like we had that.
